requiredFindings.title: The host census omits store_gc
requiredFindings.failureScenario: X9-5's drivers are finalize_commit and store_gc. Item 12 assigns X9-5 F53's store-gc step, and F53 kills at x6.sweep.settle.commit before and after. x6.sweep is Access::Durable, so a recorded point enters the kill set at occurrences 1, (n+1)/2 and n. check-unit refuses a killed point outside that set. r10's census is two unarmed finalize runs, a lawful commit and an exhausted-carrier commit, with the fixture and candidate children excluded. That covers F32's rollover, which finish reaches only after CarrierCapacityExhausted. finalize does not call maintenance::run or settlement_sweep, so the trace has no x6.sweep point. F12 and F40 kill inside finalize, on x3c.evidence, and are covered. F53's kills are not. r8 makes a unit's census the census of its own drivers. X9-3's sweep census is another target and another matrix.json. Required: union an unarmed store_gc run, twice and equal, with the two finalize runs under the same larger-count rule. Alternatively, place F53's process-death kills in X9-3's file and state that X9-5's F53 rows kill no point outside the finalize union.

scope: Law X9 r10. Host runners, host order, and the separate required-runs file are sound. RF-1: the host census is finalize only, so F53's x6.sweep kills fall outside X9-5's kill set. No accepted outcome changes. No product cargo.
